content: Keratinocyte carcinomas (also termed keratinocyte cancers) are a group of nonmelanoma skin cancers arising from the keratinocyte found in the epidermis of the human skin, namely:[1][2][3]
<info> Cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma in situ or Bowen's disease (cSCC in situ)
